land_source: R spData Natural Earth low-resolution world land union, all countries within original rectangle
area_sensitivity: cosine latitude on retained grid; identical labels and times
threshold_sensitivity: every second threshold at both offsets; no refitting
regression: weighted ridge least squares for proportion responses; predictions clipped to [0,1]
tuning: nested five-year blocked CV with one-calendar-year buffer, same folds all summaries; choose alpha separately per outcome by equal-year/equal-month MAE averaged across all thresholds and all days; one alpha per outer fold/method/outcome

features.mean: primary regional mean and day-of-summer quadratic B-splines
features.simple: mean + spatial variance + signed OLS latitude slope + primary Voronoi-area weighted exceedance proportion, each with same spline basis
features.variogram: simple + log(binned semivariance/V), five pair-distance quantile bins fixed by coordinates
features.graph: simple + log(Q_h/V), original five physical bandwidths

zero_rule: if V==0, all shape ratios take continuous constant-field convention 0 on log scale; if V>0 any nonpositive Q/bin energy triggers diagnostic failure, no epsilon
interpolation: piecewise linear in original projected kilometre coordinates; nearest original node outside convex hull; no tuning
uncertainty: paired calendar moving-block bootstrap of annual summaries, length 5, 1999 replicates, seed 20260907; pointwise 95% bands; shared resampling all thresholds/outcomes; no daily iid inference; model comparison intervals conditional on fitted cross-validation predictions
